shortDescription: Canada's main stock index opened lower on Tuesday as rising bond yields globally and declines in precious metal prices dampened risk appetite, while an uptick in oil prices kept broader declines in check.The S&P/TSX Composite Index TSX:TSX was down 0.6% at 36,054.70 at 09:31 a.m. ET.
